en-US:
Stick left/right: seek backward/forward
Hold stick left/right: rewind/fast-forward 30s
Stick forward/back: adjust screen distance
Hold trigger: play at 2x speed
Grip: move screen
Press stick: reset screen position
zh-Hans:
摇杆左右：步进/步退
摇杆左右长按：30s 快进/快退
摇杆前后：调整屏幕距离
板机键长按：2x 快速播放
抓取键：移动屏幕
按下摇杆：恢复屏幕位置
